Q1: The hazard profile for Sodium polyphosphate is largely characterized by data deficiencies. Six of the seven hazard classes—Carcinogenicity, Mutagenicity, and Reproductive hazards (CMR); Environmental (ENV); Endocrine Disruption (EDC); Inhalation (IHL); Dermal and Eye (SKN); and Organ and Systemic (OGN)—are classified as Tier 4, indicating insufficient information for a confident hazard assessment. Only oral hazards (ORL) show a Tier 3 rating, suggesting direct studies support a low to moderate concern for this exposure route.
